subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-08-14
html:
Week 11 Pulse

Shipped since last pulse (2026-08-07): the "Client Reporting for Agencies" blog post (2026-08-10, targeting the single lowest-KD keyword in the whole audit — client reporting, KD 6) and the "Agency Client Churn Warning Signs" blog post (2026-08-13, closing the most-repeated open NEXT item on the worklog, open since 2026-07-16). Connector matrix and comparison hub both remain fully caught up with no further items until a human unblocks catalog.ts. The headline this week: rank positions are still flat at zero after two full weeks of daily checks — see below.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 API access. Waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

Second full week of daily position checks for the askarlo.app SE Ranking project (site_id 12704162, Google US), 2026-08-07 through 2026-08-14. Result: still 0 of 22 tracked keywords have a measurable position (all outside the top 100) on every single day checked, no exceptions.

Checked every daily position (08-07 through 08-14, 8 consecutive days, all 22 keywords) directly via getKeywordStats rather than just the two endpoints — pos: 0 (unranked) on literally every keyword/day combination, no partial or flickering rankings anywhere in the window. Month 2 KPI #1 ("first measured position for ≥15 of 22 keywords") and KPI #2 (3 lowest-KD terms entering top-50) are both off track at the two-week mark of a four-week goal window. Two content-only sessions since the last pulse haven't moved rank yet — consistent with the plan's own "content alone doesn't rank a DA-0 domain without off-page signal" framing, but worth flagging plainly now that it's a second consecutive zero rather than a week-1 baseline.

Traffic vs last week

Pending / unchanged. SE Ranking's own organic + paid index (getDomainOverviewByCountry, US) still shows zero indexed keywords for askarlo.app — consistent with 0/22 tracked positions above. Backlinks (getBacklinksSummary, domain mode): still 2 backlinks / 1 referring domain, still only from futurlabs.dev — no change since 2026-08-01, now 6 weeks flat. AI search overview (getAiSearchOverview, US): still null brand_presence, 0 link_presence, 0 ai_opportunity_traffic — unchanged from every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No build/pipeline regressions. Clean rm -rf .next && npm install && npm run build this session — compiled successfully, same 9 pre-existing (app)/* + /welcome prerender failures as every prior session (missing NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL, Vercel-only secret), not a regression. SEO Report Email Action: 20 of 21 runs green all-time (same single historical failure as every prior pulse — the first shakeout run on 2026-07-04); both sessions since the last pulse (2026-08-10, 2026-08-13) sent and archived cleanly.

catalog.ts drift is now further past its own stated ETAs. Re-checked src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts this session: meta_ads ("May 2026") is now 3+ months overdue; hubspot and mailerlite (both "July 2026") are now also past due; mailchimp ("August 2026") comes due this month. salesforce/pipedrive still waitlist; gohighlevel/clarity/gtm still absent from the catalog entirely. Open since 2026-07-20, now 9+ sessions, still needs a human product-owner call before any of these connectors can get a public marketing page.

Off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 — the single most overdue item on the whole plan, flagged since Week 4, still blocked on a human with a browser (this sandbox has no outbound HTTP). GSC submission is also still open, unchanged since kickoff (2026-07-04).

Reading the week

Content production held its pace — two blog posts shipped, both closing genuinely overdue gaps rather than adding volume: the lowest-KD keyword in the whole audit (client reporting, KD 6, never targeted in 11 prior sessions) and the single most-repeated open NEXT item on the worklog (the agency-churn piece, flagged in every list since 2026-07-16). That's the right response to a domain with two structural blockers still sitting untouched. But the rank data is the real story this week: zero of 22 tracked keywords have moved off "not ranked" in two full weeks of daily checks, and the backlink profile hasn't grown past its original single referring domain in six weeks. Content alone was never going to fix that — off-page link-building (0/6, most overdue item on the plan) and the catalog.ts connector decisions (9+ sessions open) are the two levers that actually move this, and neither is human-independent. Worth a direct nudge to get a human 20 minutes on either one before the next pulse, since three more content-only sessions in a row without movement on either blocker would be a signal worth escalating harder than this note does.
